blocks: The current pre-selection procedure started on December 22, 2025. Please note that the deadline for Non-EU candidates (visa applicants) expired on May 15, 2026 . The application process will remain open until July 31, 2026, exclusively for EU and EU-equivalent candidates (who do not require a visa).
Admission requirements (2026/2027 - .pdf link updated June 8th, 2026)

Pre-selection , mandatory for programmes in English and a few programmes in Italian listed in the Admission requirements document above, is only one of the necessary steps for admissions . For the whole procedures please go to the International Student Office page. If you are interested in other programmes go to the International Student Office page as well.
International Student Office
All other candidates (EU or equivalent): deadline set on July 31, 2026.

A pre-selection application is an online application allowing international students to be assessed well before the official Call for applications is published in the Course catalogue. Pre-selection is available for most English-taught Bachelor's and Master's programmes not requiring an in-person admission test, and for a limited number of Italian-taught programmes.
Transcript of Records
Here are the main steps international students have to follow to apply to one of our programmes:
Complete a pre-selection application on MoveIn (if available for your programme, see list in the Admission requirements document)
Admission requirements

Follow the instructions for the whole procedure contained on the International Student Office page and in your programme's "Call for applications" available in the Course catalogue (Call for applications are published not before late June. Read the "Apply Section").
Students applying for a Bachelor's programme must hold a high school diploma earned after at least 12 years of studies;
Please carefully review the English language requirements for admission to English-taught programmes.
Pre-selection fee, tuition fees and benefits, scholarships

All pre‑selection candidates are required to pay a €30 application fee for each submitted application (up to a maximum of two applications per candidate per intake). No application fee waiver is available under any circumstances.

Full tuition for our Bachelor's and Master's programmes is € 300-1500/year, according to country of residence (visit the page Tuition fees and Benefits for further details). We are able to offer such convenient rates thanks to public funding by the Italian Ministry of Higher Education.
